name: Mathias and the Defias
label: Quest
description: SI:7 reports unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall. You are sent to Agent Kearnen for a debriefing near an abandoned Alliance watch tower.
intro: SI:7 reports unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall. You are sent to Agent Kearnen for a debriefing near an abandoned Alliance watch tower.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not a moment too soon, friend. SI:7 reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall.
It would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the Redridge supply route.
Get to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.
...and friend, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.
